featured.text: Nearby: The action of 12 March 1672 was a naval battle of the Third Anglo-Dutch War between a squadron commanded by Sir Robert Holmes and Sir Frescheville Holles against the Smyrna convoy, which was protected by 5 warships under De Haaze and Cornelis Evertsen.

all.text: At this latitude, the Earth's spin carries the ship east at about 660 mph, whatever the captain is doing.
The sun reaches its highest point here at almost the same moment as in Southampton.
Drill straight through the Earth from here and you'd surface at 50.5°S, 179.0°E, about 810 km from Dunedin.
This far north, they're roughly level with Vancouver, even though it's a world away.
The seabed is roughly 31 m below the ship.
